title: Direct entry: backchannel authentication request
description: Parameters a client posts (form-encoded on the wire, shown here as JSON) to the CIBA backchannel authentication endpoint. The unsigned group (or canonical limits body) is the thing consented to; for the wallet scopes authorization_details is built by Biatec OIDC and is never accepted from the client. Protocol 1.2: a relying party (a client without wallet scopes, spec chapter 14) sends scope `openid` and exactly one authorization_details object of the type payment, login or action, without `origin` (Biatec OIDC adds it when it has one); `login_hint` is then the linked `subject`.

login_hint.description: Identifies the user to be asked; for a relying party the `subject` of the link (spec section 14.3).

items.description: Base64 unsigned transaction (Algorand) or a single base64 PSBT (Bitcoin).

binding_message.description: Optional purpose text. Rendered, and therefore signed, only for clients chaining to a recognized trust anchor; otherwise the signed value is the empty string.

origin.description: Origin of the requesting surface, used for pending-request and pause scoping (rule 10).

authorization_details.description: Relying parties only (scope `openid`): exactly one payment, login or action object, without `origin`.
